_comment: Scenario: create_complex_order with type=OTOCO and STO legs inside trigger-order, but orders[] is empty (no bracket children). tt-require-bracket must BLOCK (exit 2) because the OTOCO structure is present but there are fewer than 2 child bracket orders. Verifies that the hook correctly reads opening legs from trigger-order.legs (not a flat top-level legs key) and then validates the bracket children from orders[].
